column.name: subject
column.value: Your driver license is no longer valid

insert.column:
Hello{{#firstName}} {{firstName}}{{/firstName}},
the driver license assigned to your courier account ({{supplierCode}}) is no longer valid. Your account has been suspended and your vehicle, delivery area and API key have been unassigned.
To resume work, please update your driver license details with your supervisor.
Best regards, {{fromName}}
